name: Sage
description: Build and run multi-agent workflows with a shared Python runtime, desktop and self-hosted web apps, durable sessions, MCP tools, and human approvals.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Flows
skills.description: Compose agent flows in the Python runtime or coordinate Studio members through directed messages.

skills.name: Durable Sessions
skills.description: Keep session history across runs and resume work after human input or approval requests are answered.

skills.name: MCP Tool Integration
skills.description: Connect configured MCP servers and discover their tools for use alongside built-in tools and Skills.

skills.name: Self-Hosted Agent API
skills.description: Expose agents from a self-hosted Sage Server through authenticated HTTP and streaming A2A interfaces.

authInstructions: Self-host Sage Server and configure its authentication and your model provider credentials. There is no public hosted Sage API endpoint; model services may charge usage fees.
